verdict.rationale: Circle supplies building blocks for autonomous background activity: Agent Wallets let an AI agent hold funds and transact onchain autonomously within spending policies, and Agent Nanopayments let agents pay per request for x402 services. CCTP can also trigger automated actions on the destination chain after assets arrive, and webhooks push state changes so an app can react. However, the user must build and host the agent or automation logic. The evidence shows no first-party scheduler, workflow builder, or managed background-automation runtime. Missing for 10: native automation or workflow setup, scheduling or recurring jobs, a managed runtime for background agents, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
